evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating a game (name and optional description are attributes of that one feature).

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round by entering an item (field details are attributes).

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the list of items for the session.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting an item (re-estimate is the same action applied again).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item to the list.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item (attributes of editing not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing all estimates immediately (behaviour described is part of that feature).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting average as the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: auto-fill estimate based on unanimous card (condition is part of the feature).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: entering the final agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories from a spreadsheet.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing copy/paste import; distinct from but still one feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing prior games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing a game's transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript as HTML (format is an attribute of the export feature).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript as CSV (format-specific export is one feature).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game and its stored data.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation (multiple input fields are attributes of that feature).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: logging in with credentials.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: updating account details.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion (consequences described are part of the one feature).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying dates/times in user's timezone.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2 ...} or {0, 1, 2 ...}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting the card/value set (enumeration describes the options, not separate features).

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: limiting number of invitees to 15 (capacity attribute of inviting).

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game by entering a name (mechanism is attribute).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying the current item being estimated.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the session's item list.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediate visibility that a specific estimator has submitted an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: simultaneous reveal of estimates after all have submitted.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until reveal (condition describes when permitted).

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing historical estimates for the current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing mapping of estimators to their estimates in current round.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a shared two-minute countdown timer.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic timer reset behavior (part of timer feature).

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing past stories and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering across draws.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes before draw completion.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying a thumbnail photo next to played cards.

evaluations.evidence: written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ensuring compliance with XHTML/CSS standards (standards listed are attributes of the compliance requirement).

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing a glossary of terms.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating database indexes to improve query performance.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: cross-browser compatibility (multiple browsers enumerated are targets, not separate independent features).

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: performance/responsiveness expectation.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support for multiple languages.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: human-friendly URL scheme.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: user-friendly error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: anonymized storage of results (privacy requirement).

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing usage metrics.
